//libraries: Folders to scan. ~ is expanded. Add more anytime, then hit Rescan in the app.
//maxDepth: How many subfolder levels deep to look inside each library.
//minSizeMB: Hide files smaller than this, so screen recordings and clips don't clutter the TV. The app has a 'Show everything' toggle that ignores this.
//exclude: Folder name patterns to skip entirely. Supports * wildcards.
